test_inputs.explanation: The agent repeatedly visited the Magento Manage Products grid at `http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/catalog_product/` and then navigated to the mass action attributes page at `http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/catalog_product_action_attribute/edit/`, which indicates the mass action used was "Update Attributes". The intermediate navigation through the product grid and then to the mass action edit URL implies products were selected prior to applying the action; with no evidence of individual row navigation, the most consistent assumption is that the agent used a bulk selection method such as 'Select Visible', so `selection_mode` is set to "visible". There is no evidence in the trace that product status or meta title values were changed on the form (no URLs or parameters reflecting status or meta title changes), so `status_value` and `meta_title_value` are set to null to indicate they were not used.
